hdr.title: Flight analysis
hdr.subtitle: Wickipartners Ballonteam
footer.rights: All rights reserved – Wicki Partners Ballonteam
footer.local: All calculations run in your browser.
imp.dropTitle: Drop files or a ZIP here
imp.dropHint: CSV, JSONL, GPX, KML/KMZ, IGC, TXT – several files or a whole ZIP
imp.hideOther: Hide recordings of other flights (far outside the time range)
imp.devicesSub: {n} devices recorded the same flight; overlap {dur}. How should the track be built there?
imp.consensusNote: Where recordings overlap, each grid point takes the median of position and altitude of all devices; devices more than 300 m from the median are ignored there ({grid} grid points, {rejected} rejected samples). Outside, each device keeps its full resolution.
imp.primaryNote: The primary device provides the track; the other devices only fill its gaps ({dur}).
imp.otherText: These recordings are far in time from the main flight ({main}) – probably an earlier flight that came along by mistake. Ignore them?
imp.profilesHint: Profiles are recognised by the header line. The profile assistant describes unknown formats; saved profiles apply to all personal PINs (blue = own, grey = by others).
imp.resetText: All files read, cuts and figures will be discarded. The files themselves stay on your computer.
imp.empty: No files yet. Drop tracker files or a ZIP into the box on the left.
imp.unknownNext: Unknown format and file too large for the assistant – please send the file to Balthasar.
imp.status: New flight · {files} file(s) · {segs} segment(s) used · {points} points · {unknown} unknown
cln.leg.hint: Drag the handles or type times on the right.
cln.noTrack: No track yet – import files first.
cln.bannerTrim: Ground points before take-off ({before}) and after landing ({after}) are cut off.
cln.noLanding: No landing detected – the recording ends in flight. Set the landing manually or import more files.
cln.landingDialogSub: Pick the moment (time field, slider or click on the track) – the map shows the end of the recording with the chosen point. The place name is proposed and can be overwritten.
cln.rule.hint: Adjust thresholds in the ☰ menu; they are printed in the report.
cln.badTime: Please enter the time as DD.MM.YYYY hh:mm:ss.
cln.autoNote: Automatic: {sec} s before take-off to {sec} s after landing.
cln.mergeConsensus: Several devices ({n}: {names}): consensus median on a {step} s grid over {dur}, {rejected} rejected samples.
cln.mergePrimary: Several devices ({n}: {names}): primary {primary}, gaps of {filled} filled from the others.
cln.p.note: This log is printed in the flight report.
ana.mapLegend: ● time markers · dark halo = night (NVFR) · dashed = gap
ana.readoutHint: Move the mouse over the profile – time, altitude, vario and position appear here and on the map.
ana.legendNote: dashed green/red = take-off/landing · grey = night (civil twilight)
ana.geocodeFailed: Place names could not be fetched (OpenStreetMap/Photon unreachable) – try again.
ana.geocodeOff: Automatic place names are switched off in the settings.
st.noLandingNote: end of recording – no landing detected (set it under “Clean up”)
st.accDerived: derived from vario / ground speed (3 s)
st.touchdownSub: vario in the 5 s before landing
st.civil: civil twilight at the balloon's position
rep.title: Report title
rep.previewNote: Preview – the PDF is made with “Print / PDF” (choose “Save as PDF” in the print dialog).
rep.profileLegend: line by climb/sink rate (red = sink, blue = climb) · grey = night · terrain grey, water blue · altitude left, time UTC below
rep.protocolLine: Cut {from} – {to} ({auto}) · {restarts} restart(s) · {collapsed} duplicate seconds · {masked} altitude jumps masked · {gaps} gap(s) · detection: window {win} s, airborne from GS > {gs} kt or |vario| > {vs} m/s.
rep.status: Add master data, then “Print / PDF” – phase 1 prints a first version of the report.
exp.gpxSub: Track with a segment per gap · ele, time · vario, speed, pressure altitude as extensions · waypoints
exp.geojsonSub: LineString [lon, lat, alt] with times, points, key figures and master data
exp.kmzSub: gx:Track with time slider, absolute altitude, markers
exp.csvSub: SI units, UTF-8, semicolon – for Excel
exp.zipSub: All formats in one file: GPX, GeoJSON, KML + KMZ, CSV, key figures (JSON/TXT), master data, event log
exp.fmt.gpx: track with time, altitude, vario, ground speed; waypoints take-off/landing/time markers
exp.fmt.geojson: track and waypoints, key figures and master data as properties
exp.fmt.kml: track with time slider, KMZ = compressed
exp.fmt.stats: key figures, place names, master data, trim
exp.shareSub: Anyone with the link sees map, profile and key figures – no PIN, no editing.
exp.earthNote: Google Earth opens the KMZ with a double click and shows the time slider; Google Earth offers no direct link for external data.
exp.status: Exports are built from the cut track; resolution selectable.
settings.title: Settings
settings.geocode: Fetch place names for take-off and landing from OpenStreetMap (2 requests per flight)
settings.terrain: Ground profile and water in the altitude profile (elevation and vector data from the internet)
settings.night: Night = sun lower than −6° (civil twilight), at the balloon's own position.
settings.storage: Settings and master data stay in this browser.
start.withCodeSub: The six-character personal PIN opens your saved flights and reports and shows your logo.
start.guestSub: Analysis, report and exports – but no saving and no short link.
start.newCodeSub: Create it once, write it down, done. No password: whoever knows the PIN sees the flights under it.
start.noteItSub: It is shown here only and cannot be recovered.
start.s1: drop the tracker files or a ZIP
start.s2: merge partial recordings, set take-off and landing
start.s4: add master data, flight report as PDF
start.s5: GPX, GeoJSON, Google Earth; save and share the flight
start.formatsSub: Recognised: GB-Instrument (CSV, JSONL), GPX, KML/KMZ, IGC, GeoJSON and aprs.fi. Please send unknown formats to Balthasar; the assistant follows.
start.privacy: All calculations run in your browser. Only what you file under your personal PIN is stored (2 years from the last change).
start.noServer: No server configured (src/config.js) – the app runs locally only.
start.errFormat: A PIN has six characters from 2–9 and A–Z (no 0, O, 1, I).
start.errNetwork: Server not reachable – please try again later.
start.errTooMany: Too many new PINs from this address – please try later.
start.status: Enter your personal PIN, create a new one or try without.
fl.hint: Open loads the saved flight without re-import. The short link shows map, profile and key figures – no PIN needed.
fl.logoNote: PNG, JPEG, SVG or WebP, max. 1 MB. Without an own logo the Wicki Partners Ballonteam logo appears in the app, the viewer and on reports.
fl.defNote: Prefills empty fields in the report of a new flight.
fl.logoutNote: Removes the PIN from this browser; the flights stay stored.
fl.summary: {n} flights · {size} · kept {years} years from the last change
fl.empty: No saved flight yet. Import a flight and save it under “Export”.
fl.col.title: Title
fl.logoTooBig: The logo is larger than 1 MB.
fl.logoType: PNG, JPEG, SVG or WebP only.
fl.openReplace: The current analysis is replaced by the saved flight. Unsaved changes are lost.
fl.deleteText: “{title}” is deleted for good, including track and short link.
exp.quota: The storage of this PIN is full (300 MB).
exp.needCodeSub: With a PIN, flight, report and short link stay available for two years.
exp.saveWhatSub: Trimmed track at full resolution ({n} points, compressed), key figures and master data.
exp.saveNote: The short link then appears on the right; the report carries it in the footer.
exp.shareAfterSave: The short link is created when the flight is saved.
exp.isPublic: Anyone with the link can view the flight.
exp.isPrivate: Private – the short link shows nothing.
adm.setupSub: Once: name and Supermaster PIN (at least 6 characters). The Supermaster sees all personal PINs, flights and usage.
adm.loginSub: Sign in with name and Supermaster PIN.
adm.name: Name
adm.statsLine: {codes} PINs · {flights} flights · {size} · retention {days} days · {actions} actions in 30 days
adm.delCodeText: PIN {code} is deleted for good with all flights, tracks and the logo.
footer.server: Calculations in the browser; only what you file under your personal PIN is stored (Cloudflare).
viewer.notFound: This flight does not exist (any more) or its short link is disabled.
rep.qrNote: Map, altitude profile and key figures online:
ev.hint: Link the flight's event log, e.g. as JSON/CSV export. The events appear on the map, the altitude profile and in the report.
ev.badFile: No events found – expected is the JSON or CSV export of the reporting app (columns ts_utc, type, …).
ev.deltaNote: Δ = distance between the reported position and the track at the same time
ev.notConfigured: The server has no access to gb_flight_data (GITHUB_DATA_TOKEN missing).
ev.githubError: GitHub refused the access – check the token.
ev.pickSub: Closed flights of the reporting app; “match” = the log's time span overlaps the track.
rep.equipmentPh: e.g. basket type, burner, tracker, oxygen system
ev.notTeam: This PIN is not enabled for the event log from gb_flight_data (Supermaster → PINs → Team).
ana.ignoreLanding: Remove intermediate landing (not a real touchdown)
ana.landingIgnored: Intermediate landing removed – the two legs are merged.
ana.pinHint: A click on the map or the profile pins a moment in both.
adm.teamNote: Team = may link the event log from gb_flight_data.
imp.timelessBody: The file holds {n} positions but no times. Without time there is no duration, vario or ground speed – the file is not used.
imp.timelessAprs: aprs.fi: on the “Export” page choose the CSV (or JSON) format – every position carries its time there. The KML/KMZ from aprs.fi contains only the line.
imp.timelessNext: Please use an export with timestamps (GPX with <time>, KML with gx:Track, CSV with a time column).
imp.timelessToast: File without timestamps – see the note in the list.
imp.unknownToast: Format not recognised – see the note in the list.
imp.unknownAssist: The profile assistant reads the file, proposes the column mapping and saves the profile – the format is recognised automatically from then on.
as.title: Profile assistant
as.heading: {name} · step {step} of 3 · {mapped} of {total} fields mapped, {req} of 3 required
as.save: Save profile and read the file
as.structDelimited: Delimiter {delim}, header {header}, line ending {eol}, {cols} columns, {rows} data rows. Adjust below if something is wrong.
as.mapHint: The proposals come from column names and value ranges – please check and change where needed. Time, latitude and longitude are required.
as.noFixZero: Treat latitude = 0 and longitude = 0 as “no fix”
as.previewHint: No preview yet – “Compute preview” reads the file with the current mapping.
as.pv.notOk: Not plausible – time or position missing or mapped wrongly.
as.pv.mirror: If the sketch looks wrong (mirrored, jumps, altitude in feet instead of metres), a mapping or unit is wrong.
as.name: Tracker name
as.share: Share the profile with all PINs (recommended)
as.needPreview: Saving becomes available once time, latitude and longitude are mapped and the preview is plausible.
as.savedShared: Profile “{name}” saved and shared with everyone.
as.saveFailed: The profile could not be saved.
ph.title: Photos
ph.needSave: Photos belong to a saved flight – save it first under “Export → Save flight”; “Add photos” then appears here.
ph.needCode: Photos are stored with the saved flight on the server. Enter your personal PIN on the start page and save the flight under “Export → Save flight” – “Add photos” then appears here.
ph.empty: No photos yet. Add JPEG files from the camera or phone – the capture time (EXIF) places them on the track; they are then visible through the short link/QR code too.
ph.emptyViewer: No photos stored for this flight.
ph.hint: Hover a photo to see where it was taken on the map and profile; click opens it large. Images are stored resized to 2000 px.
ph.zoneHint: The camera clock usually knows no time zone: state what it is set to (home time, summer time = UTC+02:00). Fine offset if the clock runs fast or slow (+ = camera ahead).
ph.jpegOnly: JPEG photos only (export HEIC as JPEG first).
ph.quota: Storage of this PIN exhausted (300 MB).
ph.noTimeNote: {n} without capture time (no EXIF) – enter the time by hand, or click a point on map/profile and use “Take pin”.
ph.exifKept: Time set by hand – the EXIF time {t} is kept (“×” restores it)
ph.clearTimeExif: Remove the hand time – the EXIF time applies again
ph.editTimeTitle: Set the capture time by hand (e.g. camera clock set wrongly); the EXIF time is kept
ph.manualTitle: Capture time entered by hand (UTC) – camera time/fine offset do not apply
ph.fromPinTitle: Use the time of the point clicked on map/profile
ph.noPin: First click a point on the map or in the altitude profile.
ph.placedOff: Time stored – it lies outside the track.
ph.zoneSet: Camera time set to {tz} (from the GPS photos).
ph.noSuggestion: No suggestion possible – needs at least two photos with a GPS position.
ph.deleteText: The photo is deleted from the server for good.
